steps.content:
Beneath the ocean's surface lies the deep sea, and similarly, beneath the glamor of this city lies its dark side—<color=#fb9259>the DisCity dark web</color>, known as <color=#fb9259>DisMyth</color>.

On DisMyth, users are anonymous, untraceable, and unmonitored by law; it resembles both the chaotic high seas and a lawless swamp teeming with evil.

Malice thrives in the shadows here, concealed from the light and eager to devour the surface.

This place is a jungle, where the rules and justice under the sunlight become laughable, and dark trends often defy the current of era. For instance...
Although BR-002 has ended and the West District's reconstruction proceeds smoothly, many "heroes" face mysterious attacks. Even a certain Chief involved in the investigation has not been spared.

01:23 a.m., February 26, N.F. 114.
As the special task force returns to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: All units, head to Chief's last known signal location now! Support team, cover every entrance and exit of District 14. Catch them at all costs!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! Can you hear me?! Please respond!
She calls out desperately but hears no response from the other end of the communicator.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What about the ground-tracking bots? Get all of them online now, even the destroyed ones. I need visuals!
Amid the sounds of responses and typing, a burst of static flickers across the screen, then, the last footage captured by a robot is displayed before the entire room.
Under the night sky, a tall woman effortlessly carries the unconscious Chief over her shoulder.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...An S-Class Sinner?
Noticing the noise made by the robot, she turns her head to look at it.
Against the moonlight, no one can see her face clearly, but none can forget those calm, deep, and dangerous eyes, and the flash of light from the blade, along with the electrical sparks.

It's been confirmed that the kidnapper is a renowned legendary hitman on DisMyth, known for her speed and discreetness in completing her commissions. There are hardly any records of her online or from the authorities, a testament to her skill and carefulness.

In other words, cases that involve her are particularly challenging to tackle.

We're unable to track the shackles because the connection is too weak, or it might have been deliberately interfered with. As a result, the hitman's location, the identity of her client, and the Chief's whereabouts... are all lost in the depths of the dark web.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...The shackles are still reacting. Chief won't give up, go find him!
steps.female_content: ...The shackles are still reacting. Chief won't give up, go find her!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: He must still be fighting.
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...The door, it was this way... Ah!
In the darkness, you fall to the ground.
You sigh irritably as you feel the obstacles around your feet. After blinking several times to adjust to the darkness, you finally see…

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where did these clothes come from?!
Bearing the pain in your knees, you struggle to sit up and untangle the clothes and items wrapped around your feet.
This is the third time, the third time today.
Bedroom, kitchen, and then the living room.
It's absolutely normal to have clothes on the floor or to trip over them, and it's completely normal for the light to suddenly go out.
...But to have all these happen together is really testing one's patience!
The power went out?

You finally free yourself from the clothes that tripped you, and approach the living room window with the phone cradled against your shoulder. Through the heavy curtains that are almost pinned in place, you attempt to look outside.
You can vaguely see the flickering lights.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's light in the other apartments, only yours has lost power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Has someone found us?
You lower your voice, asking the person on the other end of the phone.
The other end of the line falls silent, the dragging sound that you have been hearing also stops abruptly.
Ah.
The person on the line lets out a soft "ah" as if she's realized something.
I forgot to pay the bill.

options: Do you remember where you're working today?

steps.content: Yes. Room 1209, Building 2, Syndicate Oldtown District.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So your memory isn't bad, but you forgot to pay the bill anyway...
As you complain, you open the phone directory on the table and search for the number of the electricity provider.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The phone still works. I'll pay the electricity bill. Do you remember the account number? Every house has one.
Yes.
I remember writing the account number on a piece of paper, just in case I forgot.

options: You forgot the number, didn't you?
Do you remember where the paper is?

steps.content: I saw it within the last seven days. It's in the living room.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want me to find a piece of paper in this junk... I mean, dark room?
You sigh and start searching for the paper in the dark.

Fortunately, she hasn't realized that if you get the account number, you can find the address of this place. In desperate need to know your location, you're diligently searching every corner of the room.
...Even though looking for that "piece of paper" in this huge junkyard is like looking for a needle in a haystack.
It has to be there. I remember seeing it before going out on a gig this week, I even made a mental note to deal with it later.
I don't make mistakes when it comes to commissions.
Is that something to be proud of? That gig she's talking about is probably the one where she kidnapped you. And there she is, explaining so calmly to you, the victim.
Wait... she said this week...
You run to the drying rack. The clothes she was wearing on the day she kidnapped you are hanging there, you rummage through the pockets and find a lump of soggy paper.
What's wrong?
You grit your teeth and tell her that that piece of paper has turned into a pulp by the washing machine.
Well, there's nothing we can do about it then. But don't worry, having the account number or not doesn't really matter now.

Because I'm out of money. The gig you took on today turned out to be a scam again. Those fraudsters said they were recruiting bodyguards, but they were actually luring people there to harvest their organs.
It's common on the dark web, and you've been carefully screening the jobs to avoid traps, but you still got fooled by one that seemed honest and decent.
It goes to show that you're truly just a rookie in these murky waters.
No worries, I took care of them all. They were no match for me.
I saved a few others who got scammed. I'll talk to them first.

options: I didn't expect you would help them.

steps.content: Well, since I saved them, they should pay up. That will make up for the lost commission fee.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If they have to take this kind of job on the dark web, they probably don't have much money, and they must be terrified now...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't make it hard for them. Hide and call the police, come back after you make sure those people are okay.
They survived, they can walk on their own.

options: Consider it a job from me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll make sweet red bean soup tonight as your payment.
Okay, I'll take it.
That's quick.
There should be a <color=#fb9259>backup generator</color> at home. Look for it. Be careful until I get back.
See you later.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hm, see you later, <color=#fb9259>Angell</color>.
You hang up and take a moment to organize the current situation in your head.

First, <color=#fb9259>you've been kidnapped</color>. Someone has hired a powerful hitman on DisMyth. Due to how hidden DisMyth is, the MBCC has been unable to locate you, and it'll be even harder to find the mastermind behind all this.

Lucky for you, this formidable hitman currently can't get in touch with her client either. It's been five days, and all she can do is keep you in this secret safe house, which also gives you some valuable time to stay alive.

Secondly, this <color=#fb9259>Angell</color>, the Top Hitman on DisMyth, an S-Class Sinner, the person who managed to break through the MBCC's defenses... seems to be a bit... unusual, casual, and unpredictable sometimes.

By a stroke of luck, or through hard work, you have gained a bit of her trust over these past few days, helping her with the household chores—something she's <color=#fb9259>not entirely</color> good at. This is an opportunity, there's a lot you can do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, the top priority for me right now is to find the backup generator and reconnect to <color=#fb9259>DisMyth</color>.
You clear your head, stand up and walk... only to get tripped by something on the ground again. This time, it's a pillow with its cotton spilling out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Survive this, you can do it.
